label: Humanitarian Deployment Planner
description: Cross-cutting planner for humanitarian / low-infrastructure deployments. Wraps an architecture + BoM in the deployment-context obligations: regional sourcing with counterfeit-risk awareness, capacity-transfer artefacts in the local language, offline-first telemetry, sustainable spare-part stocking, and named local partner ownership.

claudeKnowledge.description: Humanitarian tech deployment patterns, capacity transfer, regional sourcing, OCHA cluster coordination
